description_en: Queries the list of created data destinations
description_zh: 调用该接口查询已创建的数据目的列表
name: ListDestination

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display on each page in the response. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A string contained in the data destination name. This parameter is used to perform a fuzzy match on data destination names
parameters.help_zh: 传入数据目的名称中任意字符串，根据该字符串可检索能匹配的数据目的名称
parameters.name: search_name

parameters.help_en: The page number to display in the response. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en:
The list of data destination operation types. Valid values:

REPUBLISH: forwards the topic data processed by the parse script to another communication topic on IoT Platform.
AMQP: forwards the topic data processed by the parse script to an AMQP consumer group through data forwarding.
DATAHUB: forwards the topic data processed by the parse script to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for data stream processing.
ONS: forwards the topic data processed by the parse script to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for message distribution.
MNS: sends the topic data processed by the parse script to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
FC: sends the topic data processed by the parse script to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event computing.
OTS: sends the topic data processed by the parse script to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage
parameters.help_zh:
数据目的操作类型列表，可取值：

REPUBLISH：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至物联网平台的另一个通信Topic。
AMQP：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据流转到AMQP消费组。
DATAHUB：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。
ONS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。
MNS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
FC：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
OTS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云表格存储（Tablestore），进行NoSQL数据存储
parameters.name: types
